read_error: The source reported an error obtaining the material.
missing_date: The publication date is missing or lacks a valid time zone.
outside_period: The publication date is outside (T−24h, T].
analysis_budget_exceeded: The complete article text does not fit the remaining analysis budget (%d characters for the entire request). The article was not sent to the model and its text was not truncated. Its relevance was not assessed.
analysis_budget_excluded_item: Material %s was skipped because of the %d-character analysis budget; later materials were checked in their original order.
no_eligible_items: No articles remain eligible for the request after checking dates, text availability and the analysis budget; the model was not called.
unknown_selected_group: The model selected missing group %s; it was not included in the event order.
duplicate_selected_group: Group %s appeared more than once in the event order; the duplicate was removed.
selection_limit: The model selected more than five events; only the first five unique existing groups were kept.
incomplete_group: Group %s is missing a name, article references, or facts.
unknown_article: Group %s references material %s that is unknown or does not belong to this group.
group_and_excluded: Material %s appears in both a group and the exclusions.
unverified_fact: Group %s contains a fact without a statement, article references, or verbatim evidence.
unverified_quote: A quote in group %s for material %s is not verbatim or does not reference a source of the fact.
model_omitted_item: Incomplete analysis: the model did not report a decision about the material. This does not mean the material is irrelevant; another analysis is needed.
unassigned_item: The model skipped material %s. This is an incomplete model decision, not a finding that the material is irrelevant.
no_selected_events: The model selected no events for the final digest; material decisions are in groups and exclusions.
